name: web-search-tavily
description: The REAL web-search engine (provider id `tavily`): one HTTP POST to the Tavily /search API, the raw payload handed to the web-search@1 seam for normalization, and every HTTP failure mapped onto the typed web-search.* reasons (401/403 auth-failed, 429 rate-limited, unreachable network, bad body bad-response). It holds NO secret: the config carries the credential NAME (TAVILY_API_KEY by default) which is resolved at call time through credentials@1, so the plugin loads in a deployment that has no key and simply reports itself unavailable with the row to fix.

config.description: Which credential NAME to resolve, where the API lives and how the vendor call is shaped. Never a credential VALUE.

credential.description: NAME of the credential resolved through credentials@1 at call time (the value is never in this file, a log, an answer or a commit).

baseUrl.description: API base url; the engine POSTs to <baseUrl>/search (a test points this at a local mock).

timeoutMs.description: Per-request deadline in ms (the seam's own deadline still applies).

searchDepth.description: Vendor search depth (basic is the cheap one; advanced costs more).

maxResults.description: Results requested from the engine for a call that names none (max 20).
